About this index. Entries were assembled from first-hand knowledge of each organisation and cross-checked against official homepages, central-bank and statistics portals, university and professional-body sites, and company product pages. Where a brand has separate products (a CRM and its AI add-on, a bank and its payments API) they are listed separately when each has its own address.

Accuracy limits. Pricing and free tiers change often; treat the access labels as a rough guide and confirm with the provider. Regional availability, institutional subscriptions, licensing and student discounts are not modelled. This is a directory of websites and tools, not investment, tax or legal advice.

Adding entries. Use “+ Add resource”. Additions persist in localStorage on this machine only and can be cleared in your browser's site settings. Export CSV downloads whatever is currently filtered.
